Missing the `<View testID='lf1-cross-tool-added'>{added.map(a => <View testID={`lf1-added-${a.key}`}>Added: {a.label}</View>)}</View>` block that letters/[id].tsx has at lines 365-370. Reference: /app/mobile/app/correspondence/[id].tsx:78-91 (Card body only contains label + chip row).

Not one of the explicitly-listed screens, but worth aligning for consistency.

CrossToolChips is duplicated across letters/[id].tsx and correspondence/[id].tsx — the two implementations already drifted (letters renders the added-tag block, correspondence forgot it). Consider extracting into `/app/mobile/src/components/lf1/CrossToolChips.tsx` and importing it from both screens to prevent future parity drift.
